name: Kernel AO Oscillator
author: third-party
description: Kernel-smoothed Awesome Oscillator. Measures momentum and trend direction using kernel regression to reduce noise. Positive values indicate bullish momentum, negative values bearish momentum.

outputs.name: Current Timeframe Oscillator line
outputs.description: Main oscillator value. Above 0 = bullish momentum, below 0 = bearish momentum.

reading_guide.above_zero: Bullish momentum — valid condition for a bullish Impulse 1 in ICI setups
reading_guide.below_zero: Bearish momentum — valid condition for a bearish Impulse 1 in ICI setups
reading_guide.zero_cross: Momentum shift — can signal start of a new impulse or end of correction
reading_guide.divergence: Price making new high/low while Kernel AO does not — potential reversal warning

inputs.note: Verify settings on chart. Common inputs: fast length, slow length, kernel bandwidth
